notes.model: deepseek-flash is the model id recommended by the official docs; the older deepseek-v4-flash names are aliases of it.
notes.base_url: The adapter appends /chat/completions; https://api.deepseek.com/v1 is equally valid and is not doubled.
notes.thinking: Selected RAG profile: low reasoning; reasoning text is excluded from receipts, numeric usage retained.
notes.max_input_utf8_bytes: A UTF-8 BYTE guard on the delivered messages. It is not a token count, not a verified context-window check and not a spend cap. Token counts stay unverified until a real response reports usage.
notes.max_output_tokens: 16384 total output budget; low reasoning effort tested after high/8192 exhausted its entire output on one case.
notes.validation: E36 v3: all370 real answers complete; 95 questions received retrieved images. AI screening plus independent Claude/Codex review: strict361/370, with9 residual cases. Existing-corpus regression, not newholdout or fullretrieval rerun. See doc/DeepSeek全量生成验证.md.
